description: This file defines the UpdateRoot class in the Drupal update module, providing methods to get and set the root path used by the legacy Update Manager, including handling special cases for test environments.

classes.name: UpdateRoot
classes.description: Provides functionality to retrieve and set the root path used by the legacy Drupal Update Manager, with support for test environment adjustments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UpdateRoot object with dependencies on DrupalKernelInterface and RequestStack, and triggers a deprecation warning.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the update root path, dynamically determining it if not explicitly set, with special handling for test environments.
